title: What to Upgrade First in Capy Kingdom: Idle Shooter
subtitle: An upgrade order for coins, gems, weapons and pets that avoids common waste.
description: What to upgrade first in Capy Kingdom: Idle Shooter to progress faster: how to split coins between Power, Speed and Money, spend gems, merge items and use pets.
card: What to upgrade first in Capy Kingdom: Idle Shooter, split coins across Power, Speed and Money, spend gems wisely, merge smartly and put pets to work.

faq.q: Which Capy Kingdom: Idle Shooter upgrade is best, Power, Speed or Money?
faq.a: No single card wins. Power breaks boss walls, Speed makes the hero run faster between fights, and Money speeds up everything else. Keep all three moving and lean on Power when a boss blocks you.

faq.q: How does merging work in Capy Kingdom: Idle Shooter?
faq.a: You merge several items of the same kind and rarity into one random item of the next rarity. A merge dialog shows how many you need, what it uses and the damage change, and locked or equipped items are protected.

faq.q: Should I spend gems on crates or on buying items?
faq.a: Both work, but crates and eggs show their odds first, while the Buy a weapon and Buy a pet buttons give one random Common item and cost more with each purchase. For most players, crates and eggs are the better first spend.
